name: JavaScript - User Interaction
description: Learn to handle user clicks and create interactive elements

rules.text: Create a button and a paragraph to show the click count
rules.hint: Add: <button id="myButton">Click me!</button><p id="counter">Clicks: 0</p>. We'll count button clicks!

rules.text: Create a variable to track clicks and a function to increment it
rules.hint: Write: let clickCount = 0; function incrementCounter() { clickCount++; document.getElementById("counter").innerHTML = "Clicks: " + clickCount; }

rules.text: Add an event listener to make the button interactive
rules.hint: Connect button to function: document.getElementById("myButton").addEventListener("click", incrementCounter); Now the counter will increase each click!

completion.message: 🎉 Perfect! You've created interactive elements with JavaScript!
